pull_request.label: PR #87 · Fix Samantha island and preference behavior

findings.title: Closing Samantha leaves menu-bar space; Codex does not move closer
findings.observed: After Samantha was closed, the menu-bar space remained and Codex did not move toward the Dynamic Island.
findings.recommendation: Clear Samantha-owned activity, then compact the surviving plugin circles after the exit fade so Codex takes the nearest slot.
findings.verification: The source motion test passed on this worktree: `IslandHarnessMotionTests.testSamanthaExitReclaimsClosestHarnessSlotForCodex` (1 test). It verifies Codex takes Samantha's released harness slot after the exit fade model step. The installed menu-bar close/reflow behavior has not yet been exercised.

evidence.caption: Enabled state only; this crop does not show the close transition or resulting spacing.

evidence.alt: Cropped Agent Computer Use menu with Samantha disabled
evidence.caption: Disabled state only; this crop does not establish whether Codex reflowed.

details.Source change: IslandHub clears Samantha-owned plugin rows and releases pending controls. IslandModel compacts surviving source-group slots after the 150 ms exit fade.
details.Source verification: `ACU_ISLAND_ACTIVITY=0 swift test --filter 'CUAServiceTests.IslandHarnessMotionTests/testSamanthaExitReclaimsClosestHarnessSlotForCodex'` — 1 passed. The test waits 250 ms and asserts Codex moves to the freed slot.
details.Attribution: User report; attached crops show toggle states, not a measured transition.
details.Installed verification: The latest head was built and installed; client, Cursor, and FD integration checks passed. Samantha close/reflow was not part of those checks.
details.Installed/live verification: Pending ACU 0.2.94 installation and a real Samantha close/reflow observation. The screenshots remain toggle-state crops, not transition evidence.

findings.title: Samantha did not retrieve a relevant Context Ledger preference automatically
findings.observed: Samantha did not apply a relevant saved preference unless asked to consult Context Ledger.
findings.recommendation: When a preference is relevant to a choice, recall its active scope and rule automatically and apply it without asking the user to name Context Ledger.
findings.verification: The 31-test focused ledger suite passed. It confirms the voice system instructions direct proactive recall and the helper can return an exact scoped preference. No real user preference was read, and Samantha's installed voice/model behavior has not been exercised.

details.Source review: The existing ledger_task supports recall, preference, lookup, and capture. The PR adds proactive recall guidance; source review did not identify a missing tool capability.
details.Source verification: The system prompt says to call ledger_task proactively before preference-sensitive choices. The preference helper test saves and recalls an exact scope+rule without calling the helper model.
details.Input privacy: No preference value or original prompt is stored in this report.
details.Privacy boundary: No personal ledger rows were read or written; tests use an in-memory transport.
details.Installed/live verification: Pending an installed Samantha session where a real non-sensitive saved preference is used without naming Context Ledger.

verification_refs: plugins/agent-computer-use/runtime/voice-cua/tests/test_ledger_preferences.py — proactive recall instruction and scoped preference save/recall pass.
plugins/agent-computer-use/runtime/voice-cua/tests/test_ledger_helper.py — scoped lookups return only returned matching decision IDs; focused suite passes 31 tests.

findings.title: Samantha should save durable preferences and critical decisions
findings.observed: Durable preferences and important decisions should be captured when they are stated, then reused at the right time without reminders.
findings.recommendation: Capture durable preferences in their exact scope and rule. Use the decision capture path for critical decisions, and confirm a save only after the ledger returns a receipt.
findings.verification: The 31-test focused ledger suite passed. It verifies durable preference saves are grounded in a recent owner quote and require a receipt, and critical decision capture fails closed on missing gates. No personal ledger data was written; installed voice behavior remains untested.

details.Source change: The PR adds guidance for proactive preference capture and retrieval through the existing ledger_task tool.
details.Supersession rule: Updating a preference supersedes only an active user_decision with the same exact scope and rule. General captures do not auto-supersede; the current tool does not create an explicit supersedes link.
details.Source verification: Preference writes include exact scope+rule and return `saved` only with a decision ID. Critical capture checks require durable/model-safe status, a user quote, future trigger, changed choice, and receipt.
details.Input privacy: The report does not include a preference value or decision content.
details.Supersession behavior: Context Ledger's same-scope+rule user_decision behavior is the intended preference supersession path. General captures are explicitly not treated as superseding.
details.Privacy boundary: Tests use mocks and temporary state; no personal ledger rows were read or written.
details.Installed/live verification: Pending a real non-sensitive preference/decision test on the installed Samantha build.

verification_refs: plugins/agent-computer-use/runtime/voice-cua/tests/test_ledger_preferences.py — exact scope/rule/value preference save and recall pass.
plugins/agent-computer-use/runtime/voice-cua/tests/test_ledger_helper.py — owner quote, durable capture gates, receipt, duplicate, and uncertain-write checks pass; focused suite passes 31 tests.

findings.recommendation: Scale each package logo to fill the existing 24 pt frame and clip it to a circle. Keep the Comet glyph small enough to read clearly without adding a smaller square.
findings.verification: Four circles and the reduced Comet mark were visually checked on installed ACU 0.2.92 at PR head 126a3ac. ACU 0.2.93 at PR head 776a1d5 was rebuilt and installed; its icon-rendering source is unchanged and current client/Cursor integrations passed. No new cropped icon screenshot was captured after this reinstall.

findings.title: The disconnect check fails during the full release gate
findings.observed: The prior full release gate counted startup descriptors as disconnect growth (53 to 60, above the +4 limit). After warming the service and waiting for the documented scan, the latest installed 0.2.93 full gate passed the live-fd step without changing the limit.
findings.recommendation: Keep the service warm before the FD baseline and retain the +4 limit. No service-channel leak has been established.
findings.verification: Verified fixed on PR head 776a1d5: the latest installed release run passed live-fd (2 tests, 6.737 seconds) after the warm baseline. The overall release then stopped at microphone preflight; voice was not reached.

details.Previous full run: The descriptor count grew from 55 to 63 against an allowed maximum of 59. The isolated disconnect repeat passed 2 tests.
details.Root cause: Unknown. A descriptor leak is a hypothesis, not an established cause.
details.Release status: The previous installed 0.2.92 full release gate failed while an isolated repeat passed. The updated 0.2.93 installed release gate is still pending.
details.Current installed full run: ACU 0.2.93 built and synced from PR head 776a1d5. Source checks passed (111 test processes); build/install, signature, client, Cursor, and live-fd all passed. Microphone preflight then failed because no input device was available; voice was not reached.
details.Current isolated repeat: The updated local test warmed the installed ACU 0.2.93 service, waited 5.5 seconds, and passed both tests in 6.616 seconds with ACU_ISLAND_ACTIVITY=0.
details.Source review: SwiftNIO local source defaults allowRemoteHalfClosure to false. SocketServer releases the connection count in channelInactive and handlerRemoved. The earlier half-close diagnosis is stale; no socket leak is confirmed.
details.Release test correction: Live integration steps receive ACU_ISLAND_ACTIVITY=0 per repository policy. This alone did not clear the earlier full-run failure.
details.Baseline evidence: After the previous failure, the service held 60 lsof rows steadily for 10 seconds. The earlier 53-to-60 delta was consistent with delayed startup work; the warmed full-gate pass confirms the check no longer flags it.
details.Warm-baseline validation: The test now makes a harmless list_apps call and waits 5.5 seconds before measuring, then runs 80 disconnect cycles. It retains the original +4 descriptor limit. The installed live-fd step passed in the full run.

verification_refs: plugins/agent-computer-use/skills/macos-cua/tests/integration_service_fd_hygiene.py — installed ACU 0.2.93 at PR head 776a1d5; live-fd passed 2 tests in 6.737 seconds.

findings.title: Samantha's Context Ledger task errors and retries
findings.observed: Agent telemetry reports repeated ledger_task failures. The latest Samantha activity also contains tool errors and repeated calls with different or unknown arguments.
findings.recommendation: Build Context Ledger search queries from the concrete need and situation; stop after a rejected request instead of retrying with reworded arguments.
findings.verification: Source fix is in progress for ACU 0.2.94: lookup now searches concrete need plus situation within Context Ledger's 240-character limit, and invalid arguments are non-retryable. Focused ledger suite passed 31 tests. The fix is not installed yet, so live Samantha lookup, preference recall, and retry behavior remain unverified.

details.Agent evidence: One Grok agent finding recorded 12 ledger_task failures through 2026-11-03.
details.Latest telemetry: The 2026-11-05 Samantha activity snapshot recorded 2 ledger_task tool errors and 7 retries with different or unknown arguments.
details.Attribution limit: The tool arguments were not captured and these events are not linked to the user's preference test. Root cause and recovery are unconfirmed.
details.Observability snapshot: 9df1db7547868aeb56ca58a522ce52fdcd77a72ce0f8cbf03446e8a5f62d0918, generated 2026-11-05T17:48:42Z. The latest Context Ledger `find needs query words` error was from ACU 0.2.92; 7 retry records span Nov 4–5 and are not linked to a PR test session.
details.Source fix: Use `need` before `situation` in the Context Ledger query, cap at 240 characters, and return `ledger_invalid_argument` as non-retryable. Tool and system instructions now require stopping instead of repeating with reworded arguments.
details.Source verification: `python3 -m unittest discover -s plugins/agent-computer-use/runtime/voice-cua/tests -p 'test_ledger_*.py' -v` — 31 passed. The new tests failed before the source change and passed after it.
details.Installed/live verification: Pending PR update, ACU 0.2.94 install, and a harmless lookup/retrieval check. No user ledger data was read or written.
details.Initial release gate attempt: `python3 scripts/check.py` stopped before tests because the ACU 0.2.94 root/Cursor manifests were not aligned with the Claude/Grok manifests (still 0.2.93). Both manifests are now aligned at 0.2.94; the full gate will be rerun.

verification_refs: plugins/agent-computer-use/runtime/voice-cua/tests/test_ledger_helper.py — 18 tests passed, including concrete query composition and non-retryable invalid requests.
plugins/agent-computer-use/runtime/voice-cua/tests/test_ledger_preferences.py — verifies proactive recall/save instructions and ledger tool guidance.

findings.title: Voice response and audio delays
findings.observed: Developer Observability reports several slow voice and audio stages. These are leads, not confirmed user-facing latency defects.
findings.recommendation: Trace a fresh, short voice interaction end to end and optimize only the stage that remains slow in a linked run.
findings.verification: Fresh snapshot 9df1db7547868aeb56ca58a522ce52fdcd77a72ce0f8cbf03446e8a5f62d0918 reports speech-to-playback p95 14.8 s (p50 2.4 s, n=74, collector threshold 1.0 s). These aggregate observations are not linked to a controlled PR-build task, and the collector threshold is not an agreed product target.

details.Latest metrics: Speech-to-playback p95 14.8 s (p50 2.4 s, n=74); audio_ready p95 5.9 s (p50 249 ms, n=10); usage p95 4.5 s (p50 2.0 s, n=92).
details.Threshold note: The collector's 1.0 s threshold is an investigation signal, not a user-facing SLA. One aggregate speech-to-playback maximum is a 1,086.6 s outlier and needs run-level correlation.
details.Snapshot limits: Snapshot generated 2026-11-05 13:44 UTC. Source coverage is partial; no metric is linked to a current acceptance run.

details.Decision: No latency optimization was made without a linked stage trace and agreed target.

findings.title: Samantha startup timing needs a clean measurement
findings.observed: Telemetry shows connection and microphone-preflight delays, alongside no-input-device failures that may be environmental.
findings.recommendation: Measure a fresh startup with a known available microphone and separate device preflight from the connection and audio-ready stages.
findings.verification: Fresh snapshot 9df1db7547868aeb56ca58a522ce52fdcd77a72ce0f8cbf03446e8a5f62d0918 reports audio_ready p95 5.9 s (p50 249 ms, n=10), mic_preflight p95 2.9 s (p50 0, n=19), and realtime websocket open p95 1.9 s (p50 1.3 s, n=23). These are not measurements from one controlled current-build startup.

details.Latest metrics: realtime_ws_open p95 1.9 s (p50 1.3 s, n=23); mic_preflight p95 2.9 s (p50 0 ms, n=19); audio_ready p95 5.9 s (p50 249 ms, n=10).
details.Environment signal: The collector also recorded 9 no_input_device preflight failures. This does not establish a Samantha startup regression.
details.Snapshot limits: Snapshot generated 2026-11-05 13:44 UTC. Product latency targets and current-build reproduction are not established.
details.Telemetry provenance: The latest audio_ready sample mentions an iPhone microphone resampling from 48 kHz to 24 kHz. The event is not sufficient to attribute the delay to the app or device.
details.Decision: No startup optimization was made without a controlled installed-build run and confirmed input device.
